in_hebrew.name: Timmi
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Timmi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Timotheos, meaning 'honoring God'. Timmi is a feminine variation of the name Timothy, which means 'honoring God'. In the New Testament, Timothy is a disciple and companion of the apostle Paul, known for his faith and devotion.
